units.source_text: 一只蹬着瘦长的高跟鞋的脚，伸到吉普车的踏板上。

en.t: A foot in a long, slender high-heeled shoe reached onto the step of the jeep.

units.source_text: 这么寒冷，竟不穿袜子，我惊愕万状。

en.t: In such cold weather, she was not wearing socks, and I was utterly astonished.

units.source_text: 一眼就可以辨出这女人是以外国兵为对象的娼妇，

en.t: At a glance one could tell that this woman was a prostitute who catered to foreign soldiers,

units.source_text: 她身穿殷红的大衣，脚趾甲、手指甲都染上了同样殷红的指甲油；

en.t: she wore a crimson coat, and both her toenails and fingernails were painted the same deep red;

units.source_text: 大衣下摆松开时，露出了肮脏的毛巾睡衣。

en.t: when the hem of the coat fell open, it revealed a filthy terry-cloth nightgown.

units.source_text: 这女人也酩酊大醉，眼目发呆。

en.t: The woman too was dead drunk, her eyes vacant and dazed.

units.source_text: 那男人倒是穿着一身笔挺的军服。

en.t: The man, by contrast, was dressed in a crisp military uniform.

units.source_text: 看样子，女子是刚起床，抓去大衣被在睡衣上，围上围巾就出门来了。

en.t: It seemed the woman had just got out of bed, grabbed a coat to throw over her nightclothes, wrapped a scarf around herself, and come outside.
